verdicts.evidence: Grid of 432 configurations tested against the Theorem 3.2 bound with 0 violations when B≥2·B_min; exponential decay shown by error falling from 7.758e-01 to 1.604e-28 over 128× budget (linear fit R²=0.983); MC cross-check with 5 seeds×200k runs matches exact to 2.87e-04; mutation tests confirm the doubly-exponential schedule is load-bearing.

Exact integer bisection over 420 grid points (A up to 10⁶, δ down to 10⁻¹⁰) shows max B_req/F = 24.41 with per-A maxima non-increasing (24.41→12.63), confirming the O(·); mutation test dropping the inner log shows ratio growing unboundedly (24.41→168.58), proving the log factor is necessary.

Exhaustive multinomial enumeration over 8 target δ values shows 0 violations of Props 4.2/4.3; strongness verified by fitting T*_δ = L·f(δ₀) yielding slope 578.07 vs predicted 577.08 (R²=0.99993); event simulation matches exact to 2.4e-20; mutation replacing majority voting yields error 0.9935 with no decay.

Structural check confirms phase lengths T_i=2^i·Q depend only on (i,Q) with standing recommendation at all t∈[1,5000); Props D.3/D.4 show 0 violations over 80,004 horizons; Theorem D.5 shows 0 violations over 21 pairs with error dropping by 4.29e9×; mutation tests show constant phases stall at error 1.0 and sub-geometric growth fails Prop D.4.

Heterogeneous-noise component is verified (Theorem 5.1 with 0/3 violations, end-to-end FC2FB(PE-KHN) showing monotone error decay, K⁷ vs K⁹ confirmed via sympy, mutation showing 4.85× budget blowup), but linear bandits (Cor 5.4) and unimodal bandits (Cor 5.7) were not attempted due to dependence on external algorithms.

overall: The logbook provides concrete numerical verification of Claims 1–4 through grid searches, exact computations, Monte Carlo cross-checks, and mutation tests that confirm the mechanisms are load-bearing. Claim 5 is only partially addressed: the heterogeneous-noise application is thoroughly verified, but the linear and unimodal bandit applications are not attempted.
